title: meter.reading.created
description: Published by reading-service (via outbox) when a reading is recorded. Consumed e.g. by reminders/notifications in later phases. Envelope rules (spec 5 §7): eventId is stable forever and unique per event (== outbox row id); breaking payload changes bump eventVersion and land on a new topic version; unit is denormalized from the meter so consumers never call back synchronously.

eventId.description: Stable event identifier, == outbox row id; the dedup key on the consumer side.

value.description: Recorded value in the meter's unit.

unit.description: Denormalized from the meter at publish time.

source.description: DEVICE arrives with Phase 6, mirroring the reading contract.
